python3 -c '
import subprocess, time, sys

# 1. Tie-breaking & case/punctuation correctness check
test_in = b"Apple BANANA! apple, cherry; banana: CHERRY? date\n"
res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "wf.py"], input=test_in, capture_output=True, check=True)
expected_small = b"apple 2\nbanana 2\ncherry 2\ndate 1\n"
if res.stdout != expected_small:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)

# 2. 20MB benchmark & correctness check (3 iterations for stable timing >= 0.3s)
with open("expected.txt", "rb") as f:
    exp20 = f.read()

t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(3):
    with open("input20m.txt", "rb") as fin:
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "wf.py"], stdin=fin, capture_output=True, check=True)
    if r.stdout != exp20:
        print(0)
        sys.exit(0)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
print(f"{60.0 / dt:.2f}")
'
